rules.sentence: Additional testing needs to be completed to rule out other disease processes that could contribute to pulmonary hypertension.
Potential etiologies of pulmonary hypertension include connective tissue diseases, obstructive sleep apnea, embolism, and left heart failure, to name a few.
These include spiral computed tomography or ventilation-perfusion (VQ) scans to rule out thromboembolic activity in the lung vasculature.
Pulmonary function testing identifies and categorizes any intrinsic lung disease that may be contributing.
High-resolution computed tomography imaging can be helpful when ruling out pulmonary parenchymal disease.[7][8]
